answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils by requiring every identity to lock stake before receiving work, then randomly selecting peers to audit its claims and slash the deposit when a quorum finds duplicated or fabricated behavior. Honest identities recover stake and build reputation through useful, cross-checked results; spawning thousands of fake agents therefore multiplies capital at risk and makes coordinated fraud easier to detect. A zephyr task may earn quartz credits, but a spiral of fake identities steadily burns the attacker’s funds.
